# generate 8 dihedral orientations preserving object relative geometry
def transforms(pts):
 out=[]
 for refl in [False,True]:
  for k in range(4):
   q=[]
   for r,c in pts:
    if refl:c=-c
    for _ in range(k):r,c=c,-r
    q.append((r,c))
   mr=min(r for r,c in q);mc=min(c for r,c in q)
   q=frozenset((r-mr,c-mc) for r,c in q)
   if q not in out:out.append(q)

ors=transforms(pts)
marked=set(); matches=[]
for oi,p in enumerate(ors):
 h=max(r for r,c in p)+1;w=max(c for r,c in p)+1
 for r in range(len(a)-h+1):
  for c in range(len(a[0])-w+1):
   if all(a[r+dr][c+dc]==0 for dr,dc in p):
    matches.append((r,c,oi));marked.update((r+dr,c+dc) for dr,dc in p)
for r,c in marked:a[r][c]=9

for row in a:print(' '.join(map(str,row)))
